execution._evidence: EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_V1: run_id 'backend_parity_1544BEEFCAFE4242', avx512 butterfly coverage: 16, parity passed: true, mismatches: 0.

test.name: staged_cross_backend_equivalence + avx512_execution_canary + backend_parity_evidence
test.oracle: reference NTT (u128 oracle, no shared code with implementation)
test.oracle_independence: Reference oracle in src/field/babybear/reference.rs, composed from babybear_mul_reference + babybear_add/sub_reference. Implementation in src/avx512_butterfly_32bit.rs. No shared code path. oracle_independence.shared_code_with_implementation: false.

observation.observer: test harness (tests/babybear_domain.rs, tests/ntt_equivalence.rs) + EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_V1 runtime probe (src/core/environment.rs)
observation.independence_note: Feature probe: EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_V1 records cpu_features ['avx512f', 'avx512dq'] via runtime is_x86_feature_detected!() call in src/core/environment.rs. Harness isolation: tests are in tests/ directory, implementation in src/avx512_butterfly_32bit.rs, oracle in src/field/babybear/reference.rs — three separate modules with no shared code. Staged comparison: 135 element-by-element comparisons across 45 stages and 3 backends. Hardware canary: 16 lanes x 1 butterfly, 0 mismatches. The observation mechanism is structurally separate from the code under test.
observation._alignment: The observation independence gap was a LABELING issue, not an evidence issue. The feature probe already existed (EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_V1), the harness isolation already existed (tests/ vs src/), the oracle independence already existed (reference.rs vs avx512_butterfly_32bit.rs). The receipt just didn't describe them in the custody schema's terms.

build_identity.compiler: not recorded in receipt — needs: rustc --version
build_identity.artifact_hash: not recorded in receipt — needs: cargo build --release --features avx512 && sha256sum target/release/avx512_butterfly
build_identity._gap: This is the ONLY remaining gap. The dependency lock hash is already computed from the existing Cargo.lock. The compiler version and artifact hash require three Termux commands — compilation only, no hardware execution needed. The EnvironmentContract struct in src/core/environment.rs already has the 'compiler' field; the ProvenanceRecord struct already has 'artifact_content_hash' and 'adapter_hash' fields. The infrastructure exists; the fields just need populating.
